properties.notes: For planning history search for 'Anglia Square' at the link provided. Application pending (18/00330/F) for Part Full/Outline application for the comprehensive redevelopment of Anglia Square and adjacent land on Edward Street for: up to 1250 dwellings, hotel, ground floor retail and commercial floorspace, cinema, multi-storey car parks, place of worship and associated works to the highway and public realm areas. Planning Committee resolution 6 Dec 2018 to approve 18/00330/F but called in. Awaiting outcome of public inquiry due to start early 2020. Proposed allocated site in draft GNLP allocation for 1200 dwellings. Original planning consent for 198 dwellings unlikely to be built out.
